title: Classic Bali Honeymoon with Bali Swing
alt: The Bali jungle swing above the Tegalalang valley
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small villa property on the quiet edge of Ubud

activities.name: Kintamani with the Bali swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting, the crater lake view at Kintamani, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and a ride on the Bali jungle swing.

activities.name: Goa Gajah cave temple
activities.description: The elephant cave, an eleventh century meditation site with a carved doorway and bathing pools, fifteen minutes from central Ubud.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland for the first half, with the crater lake at Kintamani, a waterfall stop and the Bali swing over the Tegalalang valley.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Bedugul and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then the sea temple of Tanah Lot as the sun goes down.

activities.name: Water sports, Padang Padang and Uluwatu
activities.description: Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, the cove at Padang Padang beach, then Uluwatu temple above the surf for sunset.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights on the coast, with the Bedugul lake temples on the way down, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and the Uluwatu cliffs.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud villa and settle in
First evening free among the rice fields
Optional: Goa Gajah cave temple or the art market
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A ride on the Bali jungle swing, included in your package
3: Breakfast and check out, then north to the Handara gate
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
4: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat and jet ski with an instructor
Padang Padang beach in its limestone cove
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Our most affordable honeymoon. Four nights, both sides of Bali, and the swing photo everyone comes home with.
expert.tip: The swing queues are shortest before eleven, so we start the Kintamani day early. Bring a dress or shirt with some colour, it makes a real difference in those valley photographs.

summary: A five day honeymoon on a sensible budget: two nights in Ubud for the crater lake, the rice terraces and the Bali jungle swing, then two on the coast with the Bedugul lake temples, water sports and sunset at Uluwatu.
included: Included: 4 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace tour with the Bali swing; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; water sports with Padang Padang and Uluwatu.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
